name: Compressor Selection
shortDescription: Help choosing the correct FAS model by power, flow, duty, and application.
fullDescription: firstAir support helps customers compare FAS models from 3 kW to 37 kW using maximum air discharge, operating pressure, package dimensions, and application requirements.

process.title: Requirement Review
process.description: Collect pressure, air demand, duty cycle, and site details.

process.title: Model Shortlist
process.description: Compare FAS models by kW and maximum air discharge.

process.title: Quote Support
process.description: Connect the customer with sales or an authorized dealer.

name: Installation Support
shortDescription: Guidance for compressor placement, ventilation, electrical readiness, and commissioning.
fullDescription: Installation support helps customers prepare the site for air cooled FAS compressor packages, including ventilation, clearance, electrical connection, and safe commissioning checks.

process.title: Site Check
process.description: Review space, ventilation, and power availability.

process.title: Commissioning
process.description: Verify start-up, pressure, and operating conditions.

name: Maintenance Support
shortDescription: Maintenance guidance and service planning for FAS rotary screw compressors.
fullDescription: The FAS range is designed for maintenance friendly access. Service support helps customers plan inspections, parts replacement, and routine compressor care.

process.title: Inspection
process.description: Review operating hours and compressor condition.

process.title: Service Plan
process.description: Plan routine service items and genuine parts.

process.title: Support
process.description: Coordinate with the dealer network for service work.
